exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Decide to do something".

options.text: A とか B とか
Verb ることにする
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ることにする matches "Decide to do something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ることにする.
exercises.explanation: Expresses making a personal decision to do something from now on.
